newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela collected 800 bbls of Colombia oil spill.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela collected 800 bbls of Colombia oil spill.

text.p: Venezuelan emergency oil spill teams have collected at least 800 of an estimated 1,000 barrels of Colombian crude spilled after a rebel attack on Colombia's main oil pipeline two weeks ago, state oil company Maraven said.
"More than 800 barrels of crude have been collected," Petroleos de Venezuela (PDVSA) unit Maraven said in a release.
Retaining barriers to contain the flow would remain in place to keep the spilled crude away from Lake Maracaibo in western Venezuela, Maraven added.

The 1,000 barrels that flowed along Colombia's River Sardinata and into Venezuela was just part of 8,800 barrels spilled after National Liberation Army (ELN) guerrillas blew up the Cano Limon-Covenas pipeline in northeast Norte de Santander on June 15.
The crude was originally contained with the aid of floating barriers in the Quebrada Agua Linda, a tributary of the River Sardinata.
But heavy rains last weekend caused some of the crude to escape and flow across the border, the a spokesman at Colombia's Ecopetrol said earlier Wednesday.
